name: Wardrobe
description: Save your worn outfits and switch between them instantly by hotkey or menu, with a live 3D preview.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Switch outfits in the world — the game confirms the change with its own banner.
The Wardrobe window — saved outfits with a live 3D preview of the hovered one.

added: Every saved outfit now shows a number in the list — H1–H8 for the first eight (their hotkey slots), then 9, 10, 11… for the rest — so a long wardrobe is easy to scan.
